objective: Win a paid technical-writing trial by sending the one first-person developer-tools article requested in Manicule's official worldwide freelance listing.

source_need.title: Freelance Technical Content Writer
source_need.eligibility: Remote from anywhere in the world; US citizenship or visa not required
source_need.published_process: Email exactly one link to the best article written and explain why it is strong; no resume or portfolio; the interview process includes a paid trial
source_need.policy: The official listing says Manicule is hiring two or three writers. It does not promise selection, article volume, a trial, or received income.

supported_now: A first-person account of building and using a local web-and-CLI agent workspace
Hands-on engineering decisions about durable sessions, model routing, supervision, and artifact-first verification
Concrete screenshots, public source, a working package, and visible unfinished boundaries
not_proven: Any recurring article volume or full-time offer
fit.claim_boundary: The linked article and public projects support the specific first-person build story. They do not prove selection, a client result, a trial, or revenue.

application.method: One concise email to the public address in the official listing, with exactly one article link and no resume, portfolio bundle, or attachment
application.delivery_evidence: The exact public recipient, LazyingArt sender alias, subject, body, and single article URL were visibly reviewed before one Send action. The composer closed, and the Sent mailbox then showed 36 messages with the exact recipient and subject; its rendered message frame showed the LazyingArt sender alias, recipient, subject, timestamp, body, and one linked article.

article_verification.result: The live article keeps its first-person account and project evidence. Its redundant in-body H1 was removed so the WordPress title is not repeated, and the generated description now begins with the article rather than duplicating the title. GitHub, npm package metadata, and the project website remained reachable at the check.

application.policy: Do not resubmit. If Manicule replies, review the exact paid-trial scope, rate, deadline, interview access, attribution, IP, revision, cancellation, and payment terms before accepting work.
